nodes.norm_label: important: keep the reminder string free of backticks and $(...) constructs.

nodes.label: Fluid Workflow Model
nodes.author: openspec
nodes.rationale: Supports the 'actions on a change' model: apply can run before all artifacts are done, interleaved with other actions, and implementation revealing design issues should loop back into artifact updates rather than staying phase-locked.

nodes.label: Explore Mode Stance
nodes.author: openspec
nodes.rationale: Explore mode is a stance, not a workflow: thinking partner behavior with no fixed steps. Never write code while exploring; creating OpenSpec artifacts counts as capturing thinking, not implementing.

nodes.label: Planning Boundary Principle
nodes.author: openspec
nodes.rationale: The user request that triggers propose authorizes planning only - even if it asks to build or fix something. Implementation must wait for an explicit new request starting the apply workflow, preventing accidental code edits during artifact generation.

nodes.label: Capability Retirement Rules
nodes.author: openspec
nodes.rationale: A main spec.md may only be deleted when ALL conditions hold: no requirement blocks remain, spec still well-formed with ## Purpose, was not already empty, every remaining line accounted for, .openspec.yaml declares retire_capabilities: true, and path resolves inside the real specs root. Prevents accidental capability deletion.

nodes.label: Intelligent Merging
nodes.author: openspec
nodes.rationale: Unlike programmatic merging, the agent merges rather than overwrites: preserve scenarios/content the delta does not mention, keep main spec order, and never copy delta operation headers into main specs.

nodes.label: AI News Sentiment Analysis
nodes.rationale: LLM is used ONLY for news analysis, never for trade execution decisions - a deliberate safety boundary keeping AI sentiment out of the trading loop.

nodes.label: Kairos (The Opportune Moment)
nodes.rationale: Brand thesis: qualitative, opportunistic time - the fleeting decisive moment where conditions align to create an unprecedented edge. Justifies the product's focus on precision execution timing over frequency ('In financial markets, Chronos is noise - Kairos is edge').

nodes.label: Dry-Run Paper Trading Mode
nodes.rationale: Bot runs in dry-run mode against Binance Testnet by default so no real money is at risk during platform validation; live trading with real money is out of scope.

nodes.label: Two-Service Architecture
nodes.rationale: Next.js web app and Freqtrade are completely decoupled, communicating via REST API. Next.js API routes act as proxies so Freqtrade credentials never reach the browser client.
